entries.title: Proverbs 31:1
segments: ¶The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:2
segments: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

entries.title: Proverbs 31:3
segments: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:4
segments: [It is] not for kings, O Lemuel, [it is] not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

entries.title: Proverbs 31:5
segments: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted. {prevert: Heb. alter} {of any...: Heb. of all the sons of affliction}

words.text: . {prevert: Heb. alter} {of any...: Heb. of all the sons of affliction}

entries.title: Proverbs 31:6
segments: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts. {of...: Heb. bitter of soul}

words.text: unto him that is ready to perish
unto those that be of heavy

entries.title: Proverbs 31:7
segments: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:8
segments: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction. {such...: Heb. the sons of destruction}

words.text: of all such as are appointed

entries.title: Proverbs 31:9
segments: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:10
segments: ¶Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price [is] far above rubies.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:11
segments: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.

words.text: in her, so that he shall have no need

entries.title: Proverbs 31:12
segments: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:13
segments: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:14
segments: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:15
segments: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

words.text: also while it is yet night

entries.title: Proverbs 31:16
segments: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard. {buyeth: Heb. taketh}

entries.title: Proverbs 31:17
segments: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:18
segments: She perceiveth that her merchandise [is] good: her candle goeth not out by night. {She...: Heb. She tasteth}

entries.title: Proverbs 31:19
segments: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:20
segments: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy. {She...: Heb. She spreadeth}

entries.title: Proverbs 31:21
segments: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household [are] clothed with scarlet. {scarlet: or, double garments}

entries.title: Proverbs 31:22
segments: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing [is] silk and purple.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:23
segments: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:24
segments: She maketh fine linen, and selleth [it]; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:25
segments: Strength and honour [are] her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:26
segments: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue [is] the law of kindness.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:27
segments: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:28
segments: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband [also], and he praiseth her.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:29
segments: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all. {have...: or, have gotten riches}

words.text: them all. {have...: or, have gotten riches}

entries.title: Proverbs 31:30
segments: Favour [is] deceitful, and beauty [is] vain: [but] a woman [that] feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:31
segments: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
